title: Field Notes 02: Ibn Sina's Canon in seven notes
caption:
Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine, finished around 1025, was a standard textbook from Central Asia to Europe for centuries. Here it is in seven notes.

The short version: it described every person as a mix of warm, cool, moist and dry. The Arabic word for that mix is 'mizaj', and it still means temperament in Urdu, Hindi, Persian and Turkish.

History and traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.
